favourite.heading: Why South Florida can pull away
bullets: South Florida is the better football team by 21.5 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (-21.5 pts).
Conference strength differs and the in-season sample is still thin, worth 4.6 points to South Florida (-4.6 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours South Florida by 2.9 points: ball control vs front disruption (-2.9 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Bowling Green can keep it close
bullets: Playing at Bowling Green is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -47.9 to p90 -3.9 for Bowling Green, so a projection of -24.9 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
College ratings are built on twelve-game seasons against wildly uneven schedules; even a clean rating gap carries more estimation error than the number implies.
